title: Signature Universal Translator
description: Higgins' universal translator speaks every interface dialect: wrap any adaptee, translate every call, delegate faithfully. The translator is fluent.

demo.code:
import random, json, csv, io
random.seed(1001)
n=10
# Bridge: CSV -> JSON -> XML -> CSV roundtrip, verify lossless.
rows=[{"id":str(i),"name":f"item-{i}","value":str(random.randint(1,99))} for i in range(n)]
buf=io.StringIO(); w=csv.DictWriter(buf, fieldnames=["id","name","value"]); w.writeheader(); w.writerows(rows)
csv_text=buf.getvalue()
# csv -> json
rdr=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(csv_text)))
json_text=json.dumps(rdr)
# json -> xml
data=json.loads(json_text)
xml="<rows>"+"".join("<row>"+"".join(f"<{k}>{v}</{k}>" for k,v in row.items())+"</row>" for row in data)+"</rows>"
# xml -> csv (parse back)
import re
back=[]
for m in re.finditer(r"<row>(.*?)</row>", xml):
    back.append(dict(re.findall(r"<(\w+)>(.*?)</\1>", m.group(1))))
ok = back==rdr and len(back)==n
print(f"rows=10 csv_bytes={len(csv_text)} json_bytes={len(json_text)} xml_bytes={len(xml)}")
print(f"roundtrip_lossless={ok}")
print("DEMO_OK" if ok else "DEMO_FAIL")

title: Signature Schema Time Traveler
description: Higgins' schema time traveler lets old readers visit new data: compatibility checked, evolution safe, the past and future shake hands. Time travel for data.

demo.code:
import random, json, csv, io
random.seed(1014)
n=140
# Bridge: CSV -> JSON -> XML -> CSV roundtrip, verify lossless.
rows=[{"id":str(i),"name":f"item-{i}","value":str(random.randint(1,99))} for i in range(n)]
buf=io.StringIO(); w=csv.DictWriter(buf, fieldnames=["id","name","value"]); w.writeheader(); w.writerows(rows)
csv_text=buf.getvalue()
# csv -> json
rdr=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(csv_text)))
json_text=json.dumps(rdr)
# json -> xml
data=json.loads(json_text)
xml="<rows>"+"".join("<row>"+"".join(f"<{k}>{v}</{k}>" for k,v in row.items())+"</row>" for row in data)+"</rows>"
# xml -> csv (parse back)
import re
back=[]
for m in re.finditer(r"<row>(.*?)</row>", xml):
    back.append(dict(re.findall(r"<(\w+)>(.*?)</\1>", m.group(1))))
ok = back==rdr and len(back)==n
print(f"rows=140 csv_bytes={len(csv_text)} json_bytes={len(json_text)} xml_bytes={len(xml)}")
print(f"roundtrip_lossless={ok}")
print("DEMO_OK" if ok else "DEMO_FAIL")
